scripts.build: nuxt generate && node scripts/pages.mts artifact && npm run seo:verify

scriptDescriptions.help: List every npm script and its purpose.
scriptDescriptions.images:avif: Generate AVIF companions for PNG and JPG images in public and content.
scriptDescriptions.dev: Start the Nuxt development server with live reload on port 8080.
scriptDescriptions.build: Generate the static site in dist, validate its Pages artifact and verify SEO.
scriptDescriptions.start: Serve the generated static site locally; accepts an optional directory and PORT.
scriptDescriptions.analyze: Build and inspect Nuxt bundle sizes with the bundle analyser.
scriptDescriptions.typecheck: Check application types with Nuxt and native Node scripts with strict TypeScript.
scriptDescriptions.lint: Check repository code with ESLint and fail on warnings.
scriptDescriptions.lint:fix: Apply ESLint fixes and fail if errors or warnings remain.
scriptDescriptions.postinstall: Prepare Nuxt generated files and types automatically after dependency installation.
scriptDescriptions.prepare: Install Husky Git hooks automatically during npm preparation.
scriptDescriptions.test: Run the complete Playwright suite in Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
scriptDescriptions.test:lint: Run regression tests for the ESLint configuration.
scriptDescriptions.test:unit: Run Node unit tests for shared utilities and script tools.
scriptDescriptions.test:ui: Open Playwright UI mode to explore and run tests interactively.
scriptDescriptions.test:visual: Run the local visual-regression project with git-ignored baselines.
scriptDescriptions.lighthouse: Audit dist with Lighthouse CI and save reports to .lighthouseci/reports.
scriptDescriptions.pwa:screenshots: Capture wide and narrow PWA installation screenshots from BASE_URL or localhost:8080.
scriptDescriptions.parity:snapshot: Capture page and artifact snapshots from a running site; accepts --base, --out and --urls.
scriptDescriptions.parity:diff: Compare the historical baseline with .parity/local and fail on unignored differences.
scriptDescriptions.parity:verify: Check snapshots against the explicitly approved Gridsome-to-Nuxt migration differences.
scriptDescriptions.parity:sw-cutover: Verify migration from an archived Gridsome dist to the current build; requires the archive path.
scriptDescriptions.parity:update-cycle: Verify service-worker update, deferral and offline navigation; requires a previous Nuxt dist.
scriptDescriptions.seo:verify: Verify generated SEO metadata, social cards, sitemap, Markdown exports and AI policy.
scriptDescriptions.og:gallery: Generate a local HTML gallery of the built social cards for manual review.
scriptDescriptions.pages:preflight: Read Pages settings and the live domain/CSP; requires GITHUB_TOKEN and changes no hosting settings.
scriptDescriptions.pages:verify: Verify the published domain matches dist/deployment.json; accepts BASE_URL.
